verses.original: לְדָוִ֗ד מַ֫שְׂכִּ֥יל אַשְׁרֵ֥י פֶּ֗שַׁע נְֽשׂוּי־ חֲטָאָֽה׃ כְּס֣וּי
verses.transliteration: lə·ḏā·wiḏ maś·kîl ’aš·rê pe·ša‘ nə·śui- ḥă·ṭā·’āh kə·sui
verses.literal: Of David A Maskil Blessed is he whose transgressions are forgiven whose sins are covered

verses.original: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי אָדָ֗ם עָוֺ֑ן יְהוָ֣ה לֹ֤א יַחְשֹׁ֬ב ל֣וֹ בְּרוּח֣וֹ וְאֵ֖ין רְמִיָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ’aš·rê ’ā·ḏām ‘ā·wōn Yah·weh lō yaḥ·šōḇ lōw bə·rū·ḥōw wə·’ên rə·mī·yå̄h
verses.literal: Blessed is the man whose iniquity the LORD does not count against him in whose spirit there is no deceit

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הֶ֭חֱרַשְׁתִּי עֲצָמָ֑י בָּל֣וּ בְּ֝שַׁאֲגָתִ֗י כָּל־ הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- he·ḥĕ·raš·tî ‘ă·ṣā·māy bā·lū bə·ša·’ă·ḡā·ṯî kāl- hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: When I kept silent my bones became brittle from my groaning all day long . . .

verses.original: כִּ֤י׀ יוֹמָ֣ם וָלַיְלָה֮ יָ֫דֶ֥ךָ תִּכְבַּ֥ד עָלַ֗י לְשַׁדִּ֑י נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ קַ֣יִץ בְּחַרְבֹ֖נֵי סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: kî yō·w·mām wā·lay·lāh yā·ḏe·ḵā tiḵ·baḏ ‘ā·lay lə·šad·dî neh·paḵ qa·yiṣ bə·ḥar·ḇō·nê se·lāh
verses.literal: For day and night Your hand was heavy upon me my strength was drained as in the summer heat Selah

verses.original: אוֹדִ֪יעֲךָ֡ חַטָּאתִ֨י לֹֽא־ כִסִּ֗יתִי וַעֲוֺ֘נִ֤י אָמַ֗רְתִּי אוֹדֶ֤ה עֲלֵ֣י פְ֭שָׁעַי לַיהוָ֑ה וְאַתָּ֨ה נָ֘שָׂ֤אתָ עֲוֺ֖ן חַטָּאתִ֣י סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·w·ḏî·‘ă·ḵā ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯî lō- ḵis·sî·ṯî wa·‘ă·wō·nî ’ā·mar·tî ’ō·w·ḏeh ‘ă·lê p̄ə·šā·‘ay Yah·weh wə·’at·tāh nā·śā·ṯā ‘ă·wōn ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯî se·lāh
verses.literal: Then I acknowledged my sin to You and did not hide my iniquity I said I will confess . . . my transgressions to the LORD and You forgave the guilt of my sin Selah

verses.original: עַל־ זֹ֡את כָּל־ חָסִ֨יד׀ יִתְפַּלֵּ֬ל אֵלֶיךָ֮ לְעֵ֪ת מְ֫צֹ֥א רַ֗ק רַבִּ֑ים אֵ֝לָ֗יו לְ֭שֵׁטֶף מַ֣יִם לֹ֣א יַגִּֽיעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- zōṯ kāl- ḥā·sîḏ yiṯ·pal·lêl ’ê·le·ḵā lə·‘êṯ mə·ṣō raq rab·bîm ’ê·lāw lə·šê·ṭep̄ ma·yim lō yag·gî·‘ū
verses.literal: Therefore . . . let all the godly pray to You while You may be found Surely when great . . . waters rise they will not come near

verses.original: אַתָּ֤ה׀ סֵ֥תֶר לִי֮ תִּ֫צְּרֵ֥נִי מִצַּ֪ר תְּס֖וֹבְבֵ֣נִי רָנֵּ֥י פַלֵּ֑ט סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh sê·ṯer lî tiṣ·ṣə·rê·nî miṣ·ṣar tə·sō·wḇ·ḇê·nî rān·nê p̄al·lêṭ se·lāh
verses.literal: You are my hiding place You protect me from trouble You surround me with songs of deliverance Selah

verses.original: אַשְׂכִּֽילְךָ֨׀ וְֽאוֹרְךָ֗ בְּדֶֽרֶךְ־ ז֥וּ תֵלֵ֑ךְ אִֽיעֲצָ֖ה עֵינִֽי׃ עָלֶ֣יךָ
verses.literal: I will instruct you and teach you the way . . . you should go I will give you counsel [and] watch over you

verses.original: אַל־ תִּֽהְי֤וּ׀ כְּס֥וּס כְּפֶרֶד֮ אֵ֤ין הָ֫בִ֥ין לִבְל֑וֹם בְּמֶֽתֶג־ וָרֶ֣סֶן עֶדְי֣וֹ בַּ֝֗ל קְרֹ֣ב אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tih·yū kə·sūs kə·p̄e·reḏ ’ên hā·ḇîn liḇ·lō·wm bə·me·ṯeḡ- wā·re·sen ‘eḏ·yōw bal qə·rōḇ ’ê·le·ḵā
verses.literal: Do not be like the horse or mule [which] have no understanding they must be controlled with bit and bridle . . . [to make] them come to you

verses.original: רַבִּ֥ים מַכְאוֹבִ֗ים לָרָ֫שָׁ֥ע חֶ֝֗סֶד יְסוֹבְבֶֽנּוּ׃ וְהַבּוֹטֵ֥חַ בַּיהוָ֑ה
verses.transliteration: rab·bîm maḵ·’ō·w·ḇîm lā·rā·šā‘ ḥe·seḏ yə·sō·wḇ·ḇen·nū wə·hab·bō·w·ṭê·aḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Many are the sorrows of the wicked but loving devotion surrounds him who trusts in the LORD

verses.original: שִׂמְח֬וּ בַֽיהוָ֣ה וְ֭גִילוּ צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְ֝הַרְנִ֗ינוּ כָּל־ יִשְׁרֵי־ לֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: śim·ḥū Yah·weh wə·ḡî·lū ṣad·dî·qîm wə·har·nî·nū kāl- yiš·rê- lêḇ
verses.literal: Be glad in the LORD and rejoice O righteous ones shout for joy all you upright in heart
